snippet.title: Roulette Hero | Playtest is Live Trailer
snippet.description:
We are thrilled to announce that Roulette Hero's first global playtest is now LIVE on Steam! 

Join the global playtest and give Roulette Hero a spin!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3371510/Roulette_Hero/

Roulette Hero is a strategic roguelike deckbuilder where you assemble animal companions to defeat towering mechanical beasts. Line up the perfect squad on your roulette wheel, spin to activate your animals' abilities, trigger game-changing synergies, and turn the tide of battle!

Join our communities:
Official Twitter: https://x.com/CLLC_studio
Official TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@roulettehero
Official Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/rouletteherodev.bsky.social
Spiral Up Games Twitter: https://twitter.com/SpiralUpGames
Spiral Up Games Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/SpiralUpGames
